character_mapping_format: static mesh in KayKit character space (origin at feet, ~2 units tall, faces +Y). Suite attach: headgear -> head bone socket with zero offsets; tops -> spine/chest region; bottoms -> hips/legs region; cape -> neck/back socket; shields -> hand/forearm socket. Fit=auto-scale on non-standard bodies.

honest_flags: Stylized low-poly (KayKit house style), NOT photorealistic WWE 2K rips.
Rogue hood NOT separable: Rogue_Head_Hooded is a single fused mesh+material (head and hood baked together) — skipped, not shipped as a part.
Each GLB embeds its character texture (~3.2MB per part, texture duplicated across parts from the same character). Self-contained by design, matching repo convention.
Capes across all 5 characters are the same mesh; shipped once.
source: KayKit Character Pack: Adventurers 1.0, Kay Lousberg (kaykit.com), CC0-1.0. Separated from the 5 character GLBs (Barbarian, Knight, Mage, Rogue, Rogue_Hooded) via Blender mesh extraction; materials and textures preserved per part. Staged from ~/workspace/customization-pulls/kaykit/.
